title: Santa Claus Parade
summary: Join the Town of Stouffville on December 6 and celebrate the season as a cavalcade of lights, floats, bands and more will make its way down our Historic Downtown Main Street. The parade starts at 6 PM at Ninth Line and heads east on Main Street all the way to Park Drive.
description: Join the Town of Stouffville on December 6 and celebrate the season as a cavalcade of lights, floats, bands and more will make its way down our Historic Downtown Main Street. The parade starts at 6 PM at Ninth Line and heads east on Main Street all the way to Park Drive. The Whitchurch-Stouffville Santa Claus Parade is a spectacle that attracts visitors from across the region. We invite everyone in our community to see the festive holiday floats followed by the grand finale that will feature Santa Claus himself, as he greets thousands of spectators before returning to the North Pole! The Stouffville Santa Claus Parade is the perfect addition to your holiday celebrations. Don’t forget your letter for Santa, as Santa’s elves will be collecting them along the route! Street Closures Parade Safety Guidelines For the safety and enjoyment of all attendees, please remember to stay behind the curb while viewing the parade. This helps keep everyone safe and ensures a clear path for our parade participants. Additionally, we ask that you remain on one side of the street and avoid crossing while the parade is in motion. Parade marshals, security personnel, by-law officers, and York Regional Police will be present along the route to help things run smoothly. Please follow their directions, as they are there to keep everyone safe and ensure the event goes off without a hitch. Finally, we encourage you to be considerate of fellow attendees and wait for the giveaways to reach you. All giveaways will be handed out to those who stay behind the curb, so there’s no need to move into the street. Thank you for helping us make this parade a safe and enjoyable experience for everyone!
address: Main St. and Ninth Line, Whitchurch-Stouffville
